additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Please ensure that all work is carried out in accordance with applicable electrical safety protocols.
We kindly request that you visit the charger to inspect the electrical connections and assess the functionality of the converter located in DC1.
As part of the diagnostic process, please swap converter
102313PAVNSQ5002356SA002204000204
with a neighboring converter to help determine whether the issue lies with the converter itself. If a converter is missing or not powering on, please replace it with a known working unit and verify whether the swapped converter powers on successfully.
Additionally, inspect the power converter display for any error messages or indicator lights that could help identify the fault.
If all the above steps have been performed and the power converter still does not power on, please proceed with replacing it.
MLFB for Spare part order -
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 - Power Converter AC/DC 20kW

additional_info.subject: RE: A new case manager was assigned to 0423531 CRM:00225214478
additional_info.body:
Dear Valerio,
I am writing to inform you that I will proceed to close ticket
ID0423531.
On this charger, TB9 power converter was replaced on 26.05.2025 and TB2 was replaced after the onsite visit on 18.06.2025. Both power converters 40kW were showing the error E17 "Internal communication error", and both power converters have been sent to QM in LPZ for further analysis.
The topic is now in the hands of Product Care, for quality analysis on the power converters.
I will keep ticket
ID0430554
open for any further communication in regards of Product Care analysis on the E17 error. At the moment, the guideline from service is to replace the power converter, in all cases the E17 error is permanent.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
